def awq_dequantize_kernel(
        qweight_ptr,  # quantized matrix
        scales_ptr,  # scales, per group
        zeros_ptr,  # zeros, per group
        group_size,  # Should always be one of the supported group sizes
        result_ptr,  # Output matrix
        num_cols,  # input num cols in qweight
        num_rows,  # input num rows in qweight
        BLOCK_SIZE_X: tl.constexpr,
        BLOCK_SIZE_Y: tl.constexpr):
    # Setup the pids.
    pid_x = tl.program_id(axis=0)
    pid_y = tl.program_id(axis=1)

    # Compute offsets and masks for qweight_ptr.
    offsets_y = pid_y * BLOCK_SIZE_Y + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_Y)
    offsets_x = pid_x * BLOCK_SIZE_X + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_X)

    q_offsets = num_cols * offsets_y[:, None] + offsets_x[None, :]
    q_mask = (offsets_y[:, None] < num_rows) & (offsets_x[None, :] < num_cols)
    q_packed = tl.load(qweight_ptr + q_offsets, mask=q_mask)

    # Unpack 4-bit weights using tl.interleave
    # AWQ order: [0, 4, 1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7]
    w0 = (q_packed >> 0) & 0xF
    w1 = (q_packed >> 4) & 0xF
    w2 = (q_packed >> 8) & 0xF
    w3 = (q_packed >> 12) & 0xF
    w4 = (q_packed >> 16) & 0xF
    w5 = (q_packed >> 20) & 0xF
    w6 = (q_packed >> 24) & 0xF
    w7 = (q_packed >> 28) & 0xF

    low_2_0 = tl.interleave(w0, w2)
    low_2_1 = tl.interleave(w1, w3)
    low_4 = tl.interleave(low_2_0, low_2_1)
    high_2_0 = tl.interleave(w4, w6)
    high_2_1 = tl.interleave(w5, w7)
    high_4 = tl.interleave(high_2_0, high_2_1)
    iweights = tl.interleave(low_4, high_4)

    # Use per-element group offset arithmetic for zeros/scales to handle all cases
    z_y = offsets_y // group_size
    z_offsets = num_cols * z_y[:, None] + offsets_x[None, :]
    z_mask = (z_y[:, None] < num_rows // group_size) & (offsets_x[None, :] < num_cols)
    z_packed = tl.load(zeros_ptr + z_offsets, mask=z_mask)

    z0 = (z_packed >> 0) & 0xF
    z1 = (z_packed >> 4) & 0xF
    z2 = (z_packed >> 8) & 0xF
    z3 = (z_packed >> 12) & 0xF
    z4 = (z_packed >> 16) & 0xF
    z5 = (z_packed >> 20) & 0xF
    z6 = (z_packed >> 24) & 0xF
    z7 = (z_packed >> 28) & 0xF

    zlow_2_0 = tl.interleave(z0, z2)
    zlow_2_1 = tl.interleave(z1, z3)
    zlow_4 = tl.interleave(zlow_2_0, zlow_2_1)
    zhigh_2_0 = tl.interleave(z4, z6)
    zhigh_2_1 = tl.interleave(z5, z7)
    zhigh_4 = tl.interleave(zhigh_2_0, zhigh_2_1)
    zeros = tl.interleave(zlow_4, zhigh_4)

    s_x = pid_x * BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8)
    s_offsets = (num_cols * 8) * z_y[:, None] + s_x[None, :]
    s_mask = (z_y[:, None] < num_rows // group_size) & (s_x[None, :] < num_cols * 8)
    scales = tl.load(scales_ptr + s_offsets, mask=s_mask)

    iweights = (iweights - zeros) * scales
    iweights = iweights.to(result_ptr.type.element_ty)

    res_x = pid_x * BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8)
    res_offsets = (num_cols * 8) * offsets_y[:, None] + res_x[None, :]
    res_mask = (offsets_y[:, None] < num_rows) & (res_x[None, :] < num_cols * 8)
    tl.store(result_ptr + res_offsets, iweights, mask=res_mask)",
        "awq_gemm_kernel": "@triton.jit
def awq_gemm_kernel(a_ptr, b_ptr, c_ptr, zeros_ptr, scales_ptr, M, N, K,
                    group_size, BLOCK_SIZE_M: tl.constexpr,
                    BLOCK_SIZE_N: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_SIZE_K: tl.constexpr,
                    SPLIT_K: tl.constexpr):
    pid = tl.program_id(axis=0)
    pid_z = tl.program_id(1)

    num_pid_n = tl.cdiv(N, BLOCK_SIZE_N)
    pid_m = pid // num_pid_n
    pid_n = pid % num_pid_n

    accumulator_dtype = c_ptr.type.element_ty
    accumulator = tl.zeros((BLOCK_SIZE_M, BLOCK_SIZE_N),
                           dtype=accumulator_dtype)

    # Offsets and masks.
    offsets_am = pid_m * BLOCK_SIZE_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_M)
    masks_am = offsets_am < M

    offsets_bn = pid_n * (BLOCK_SIZE_N // 8) + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N // 8)
    masks_bn = offsets_bn < N // 8

    offsets_k = pid_z * BLOCK_SIZE_K + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_K)

    a_ptrs = a_ptr + (pid_m * BLOCK_SIZE_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_M))[:, None] * K + (pid_z * BLOCK_SIZE_K + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_K))[None, :]
    b_ptrs = b_ptr + (pid_z * BLOCK_SIZE_K + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_K))[:, None] * (N // 8) + (pid_n * (BLOCK_SIZE_N // 8) + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N // 8))[None, :]

    for k in range(0, tl.cdiv(K, BLOCK_SIZE_K * SPLIT_K)):
        curr_offsets_k = offsets_k + k * BLOCK_SIZE_K * SPLIT_K
        masks_k = curr_offsets_k < K

        a = tl.load(a_ptrs, mask=masks_am[:, None] & masks_k[None, :])
        b_packed = tl.load(b_ptrs, mask=masks_k[:, None] & masks_bn[None, :])

        # Unpack b_packed
        w0 = (b_packed >> 0) & 0xF
        w1 = (b_packed >> 4) & 0xF
        w2 = (b_packed >> 8) & 0xF
        w3 = (b_packed >> 12) & 0xF
        w4 = (b_packed >> 16) & 0xF
        w5 = (b_packed >> 20) & 0xF
        w6 = (b_packed >> 24) & 0xF
        w7 = (b_packed >> 28) & 0xF

        low_2_0 = tl.interleave(w0, w2)
        low_2_1 = tl.interleave(w1, w3)
        low_4 = tl.interleave(low_2_0, low_2_1)
        high_2_0 = tl.interleave(w4, w6)
        high_2_1 = tl.interleave(w5, w7)
        high_4 = tl.interleave(high_2_0, high_2_1)
        b = tl.interleave(low_4, high_4)

        # Dequantize b.
        z_k = curr_offsets_k // group_size
        z_ptrs = zeros_ptr + z_k[:, None] * (N // 8) + (pid_n * (BLOCK_SIZE_N // 8) + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N // 8))[None, :]
        z_packed = tl.load(z_ptrs, mask=(z_k[:, None] < K // group_size) & masks_bn[None, :])

        z0 = (z_packed >> 0) & 0xF
        z1 = (z_packed >> 4) & 0xF
        z2 = (z_packed >> 8) & 0xF
        z3 = (z_packed >> 12) & 0xF
        z4 = (z_packed >> 16) & 0xF
        z5 = (z_packed >> 20) & 0xF
        z6 = (z_packed >> 24) & 0xF
        z7 = (z_packed >> 28) & 0xF

        zlow_2_0 = tl.interleave(z0, z2)
        zlow_2_1 = tl.interleave(z1, z3)
        zlow_4 = tl.interleave(zlow_2_0, zlow_2_1)
        zhigh_2_0 = tl.interleave(z4, z6)
        zhigh_2_1 = tl.interleave(z5, z7)
        zhigh_4 = tl.interleave(zhigh_2_0, zhigh_2_1)
        zeros = tl.interleave(zlow_4, zhigh_4)

        s_ptrs = scales_ptr + z_k[:, None] * N + (pid_n * BLOCK_SIZE_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N))[None, :]
        scales = tl.load(s_ptrs, mask=(z_k[:, None] < K // group_size) & (pid_n * BLOCK_SIZE_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N) < N)[None, :])

        b = (b - zeros) * scales
        b = b.to(a.dtype)

        # Accumulate results.
        accumulator = tl.dot(a, b, accumulator, out_dtype=accumulator_dtype)

        a_ptrs += BLOCK_SIZE_K * SPLIT_K
        b_ptrs += (BLOCK_SIZE_K * SPLIT_K) * (N // 8)

    c = accumulator.to(c_ptr.type.element_ty)
    offs_cm = pid_m * BLOCK_SIZE_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_M)
    offs_cn = pid_n * BLOCK_SIZE_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N)
    c_ptrs = c_ptr + N * offs_cm[:, None] + offs_cn[None, :]
    c_mask = (offs_cm[:, None] < M) & (offs_cn[None, :] < N)
    if SPLIT_K == 1:
        tl.store(c_ptrs, c, mask=c_mask)
    else:
        tl.atomic_add(c_ptrs, c, mask=c_mask)"
    }

import torch
import triton
import triton.language as tl

AWQ_TRITON_SUPPORTED_GROUP_SIZES = [-1, 32, 64, 128]


@triton.jit
def awq_dequantize_kernel(
        qweight_ptr,  # quantized matrix
        scales_ptr,  # scales, per group
        zeros_ptr,  # zeros, per group
        group_size,  # Should always be one of the supported group sizes
        result_ptr,  # Output matrix
        num_cols,  # input num cols in qweight
        num_rows,  # input num rows in qweight
        BLOCK_SIZE_X: tl.constexpr,
        BLOCK_SIZE_Y: tl.constexpr):
    # Setup the pids.
    pid_x = tl.program_id(axis=0)
    pid_y = tl.program_id(axis=1)

    # Compute offsets and masks for qweight_ptr.
    offsets_y = pid_y * BLOCK_SIZE_Y + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_Y)
    offsets_x = pid_x * BLOCK_SIZE_X + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8) // 8
    offsets = num_cols * offsets_y[:, None] + offsets_x[None, :]

    masks_y = offsets_y < num_rows
    masks_x = offsets_x < num_cols

    masks = masks_y[:, None] & masks_x[None, :]

    # Compute offsets and masks for result output ptr.
    result_offsets_y = pid_y * BLOCK_SIZE_Y + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_Y)
    result_offsets_x = pid_x * BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8 + tl.arange(
        0, BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8)
    result_offsets = (8 * num_cols * result_offsets_y[:, None] +
                      result_offsets_x[None, :])

    result_masks_y = result_offsets_y < num_rows
    result_masks_x = result_offsets_x < num_cols * 8
    result_masks = result_masks_y[:, None] & result_masks_x[None, :]

    # Load the weights.
    iweights = tl.load(qweight_ptr + offsets, masks)

    # Create reverse AWQ order as tensor: [0, 4, 1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7]
    # that will map given indices to the correct order.
    reverse_awq_order_tensor = ((tl.arange(0, 2) * 4)[None, :] +
                                tl.arange(0, 4)[:, None]).reshape(8)

    # Use this to compute a set of shifts that can be used to unpack and
    # reorder the values in iweights and zeros.
    shifts = reverse_awq_order_tensor * 4
    shifts = tl.broadcast_to(shifts[None, :], (BLOCK_SIZE_Y * BLOCK_SIZE_X, 8))
    shifts = tl.reshape(shifts, (BLOCK_SIZE_Y, BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8))

    # Unpack and reorder: shift out the correct 4-bit value and mask.
    iweights = (iweights >> shifts) & 0xF

    # Compute zero offsets and masks.
    zero_offsets_y = (pid_y * BLOCK_SIZE_Y // group_size +
                      tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_Y) // group_size)
    zero_offsets_x = pid_x * BLOCK_SIZE_X + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8) // 8
    zero_offsets = num_cols * zero_offsets_y[:, None] + zero_offsets_x[None, :]

    zero_masks_y = zero_offsets_y < num_rows // group_size
    zero_masks_x = zero_offsets_x < num_cols
    zero_masks = zero_masks_y[:, None] & zero_masks_x[None, :]

    # Load the zeros.
    zeros = tl.load(zeros_ptr + zero_offsets, zero_masks)

    # Unpack and reorder: shift out the correct 4-bit value and mask.
    zeros = (zeros >> shifts) & 0xF

    # Compute scale offsets and masks.
    scale_offsets_y = (pid_y * BLOCK_SIZE_Y // group_size +
                       tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_Y) // group_size)
    scale_offsets_x = (pid_x * BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8 +
                       tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_X * 8))
    scale_offsets = (num_cols * 8 * scale_offsets_y[:, None] +
                     scale_offsets_x[None, :])
    scale_masks_y = scale_offsets_y < num_rows // group_size
    scale_masks_x = scale_offsets_x < num_cols * 8
    scale_masks = scale_masks_y[:, None] & scale_masks_x[None, :]

    # Load the scales.
    scales = tl.load(scales_ptr + scale_offsets, scale_masks)

    # Dequantize.
    iweights = (iweights - zeros) * scales
    iweights = iweights.to(result_ptr.type.element_ty)

    # Finally, store.

# qweights - [K     , M // 8], int32
# scales   - [K // G, M     ], float16
# zeros    - [K // G, M // 8], int32
def awq_dequantize_triton(qweight: torch.Tensor,
                          scales: torch.Tensor,
                          zeros: torch.Tensor,
                          block_size_x: int = 32,
                          block_size_y: int = 32) -> torch.Tensor:
    K = qweight.shape[0]
    M = scales.shape[1]
    group_size = qweight.shape[0] // scales.shape[0]

    assert K > 0 and M > 0
    assert scales.shape[0] == K // group_size and scales.shape[1] == M
    assert zeros.shape[0] == K // group_size and zeros.shape[1] == M // 8
    assert group_size <= K
    assert group_size in AWQ_TRITON_SUPPORTED_GROUP_SIZES or group_size == K

    # Result tensor:
    # number of rows = same as input tensor
    # number of cols = 8 x input tensor num cols
    result = torch.empty(qweight.shape[0],
                         qweight.shape[1] * 8,
                         device=qweight.device,
                         dtype=scales.dtype)

    Y = qweight.shape[0]  # num rows
    X = qweight.shape[1]  # num cols

    grid = lambda META: (
        triton.cdiv(X, META['BLOCK_SIZE_X']),
        triton.cdiv(Y, META['BLOCK_SIZE_Y']),
    )
    awq_dequantize_kernel[grid](qweight,
                                scales,
                                zeros,
                                group_size,
                                result,
                                X,
                                Y,
                                BLOCK_SIZE_X=block_size_x,
                                BLOCK_SIZE_Y=block_size_y)

    return result

import torch
import triton
import triton.language as tl
import sys
import os

# Add the current directory to sys.path to find vllm
sys.path.append(os.getcwd())

from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.awq_triton import awq_dequantize_kernel, awq_gemm_kernel

@triton.jit
def awq_dequantize_kernel_new(
        qweight_ptr,  # quantized matrix
        scales_ptr,  # scales, per group
        zeros_ptr,  # zeros, per group
        group_size,  # Should always be one of the supported group sizes
        result_ptr,  # Output matrix
        num_cols,  # input num cols in qweight
        num_rows,  # input num rows in qweight
        BLOCK_SIZE_X: tl.constexpr,
        BLOCK_SIZE_Y: tl.constexpr):
    # Setup the pids.
    pid_x = tl.program_id(axis=0)
    pid_y = tl.program_id(axis=1)

    # Compute offsets and masks for qweight_ptr.
    offsets_y = pid_y * BLOCK_SIZE_Y + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_Y)
    offsets_x = pid_x * BLOCK_SIZE_X + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_X)
    
    # Load the weights.
    # qweight is [num_rows, num_cols]
    q_offsets = num_cols * offsets_y[:, None] + offsets_x[None, :]
    q_mask = (offsets_y[:, None] < num_rows) & (offsets_x[None, :] < num_cols)
    q_packed = tl.load(qweight_ptr + q_offsets, mask=q_mask)

    # Unpack 4-bit weights using tl.interleave
    # AWQ order: [0, 4, 1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7]
    # This means:
    # byte 0: low 4 bits -> weight 0, high 4 bits -> weight 4
    # byte 1: low 4 bits -> weight 1, high 4 bits -> weight 5
    # ...
    
    w0 = (q_packed >> 0) & 0xF
    w1 = (q_packed >> 4) & 0xF
    w2 = (q_packed >> 8) & 0xF
    w3 = (q_packed >> 12) & 0xF
    w4 = (q_packed >> 16) & 0xF
    w5 = (q_packed >> 20) & 0xF
    w6 = (q_packed >> 24) & 0xF
    w7 = (q_packed >> 28) & 0xF
    
    # Interleave to get [w0, w4, w1, w5, w2, w6, w3, w7]
    # Wait, the AWQ order is:
    # iweights = (iweights >> shifts) & 0xF
    # shifts = [0, 16, 4, 20, 8, 24, 12, 28]
    # So:
    # index 0: shift 0   (w0)
    # index 1: shift 16  (w4)
    # index 2: shift 4   (w1)
    # index 3: shift 20  (w5)
    # index 4: shift 8   (w2)
    # index 5: shift 24  (w6)
    # index 6: shift 12  (w3)
    # index 7: shift 28  (w7)
    
    # Using tl.interleave:
    # tl.interleave(a, b) -> [a0, b0, a1, b1, ...]
    
    # To get [w0, w4, w1, w5, w2, w6, w3, w7]:
    # l1_0 = tl.interleave(w0, w4) # [w0, w4, ...]
    # l1_1 = tl.interleave(w1, w5) # [w1, w5, ...]
    # l1_2 = tl.interleave(w2, w6) # [w2, w6, ...]

        high_4 = tl.interleave(high_2_0, high_2_1)
        b = tl.interleave(low_4, high_4)

        # Dequantize b.
        z_k = curr_offsets_k // group_size
        z_ptrs = zeros_ptr + z_k[:, None] * (N // 8) + (pid_n * (BLOCK_SIZE_N // 8) + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N // 8))[None, :]
        z_packed = tl.load(z_ptrs, mask=(z_k[:, None] < K // group_size) & masks_bn[None, :])

        z0 = (z_packed >> 0) & 0xF
        z1 = (z_packed >> 4) & 0xF
        z2 = (z_packed >> 8) & 0xF
        z3 = (z_packed >> 12) & 0xF
        z4 = (z_packed >> 16) & 0xF
        z5 = (z_packed >> 20) & 0xF
        z6 = (z_packed >> 24) & 0xF
        z7 = (z_packed >> 28) & 0xF

        zlow_2_0 = tl.interleave(z0, z2)
        zlow_2_1 = tl.interleave(z1, z3)
        zlow_4 = tl.interleave(zlow_2_0, zlow_2_1)
        zhigh_2_0 = tl.interleave(z4, z6)
        zhigh_2_1 = tl.interleave(z5, z7)
        zhigh_4 = tl.interleave(zhigh_2_0, zhigh_2_1)
        zeros = tl.interleave(zlow_4, zhigh_4)

        s_ptrs = scales_ptr + z_k[:, None] * N + (pid_n * BLOCK_SIZE_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N))[None, :]
        scales = tl.load(s_ptrs, mask=(z_k[:, None] < K // group_size) & (pid_n * BLOCK_SIZE_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N) < N)[None, :])

        b = (b - zeros) * scales
        b = b.to(a.dtype)

        # Accumulate results.
        accumulator = tl.dot(a, b, accumulator, out_dtype=accumulator_dtype)

        a_ptrs += BLOCK_SIZE_K * SPLIT_K
        b_ptrs += (BLOCK_SIZE_K * SPLIT_K) * (N // 8)

    c = accumulator.to(c_ptr.type.element_ty)
    offs_cm = pid_m * BLOCK_SIZE_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_M)
    offs_cn = pid_n * BLOCK_SIZE_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_N)
    c_ptrs = c_ptr + N * offs_cm[:, None] + offs_cn[None, :]
    c_mask = (offs_cm[:, None] < M) & (offs_cn[None, :] < N)
    if SPLIT_K == 1:
        tl.store(c_ptrs, c, mask=c_mask)
    else:
        tl.atomic_add(c_ptrs, c, mask=c_mask)"
    }
}
